stories.title: Build the judge-v1 labeled proposal set (≥50 risk + intent-verification labels)
stories.scope: Create porting/calibration/ (new dir). capture.mjs freezes our own proposals as judge inputs in the exact JudgeRepoInput shape (repo, intent, files[{path,status,intent,patch}]) from the live platform — demo scenario change-sets across resets, real agent runs, seeded scenarios — into porting/calibration/judge-v1/proposals/*.json; extend by running additional real agent tasks until ≥50 unique change-sets exist (never synthetic-only). labels.json: { setVersion:'v1', proposals:[{id, repo, fixture, label:{risk: routine|focused|senior-security, intent: supports|contradicts|insufficient}, labeledBy, labeledAt, notes}] } — vocab per CONTRACT.md:145-151; labels are human ground truth, not model answers. validate-labels.mjs enforces count, both labels present, vocab values, unique ids, fixture files exist. No model calls here; this set feeds evaluate.mjs and injection-spike.mjs. Refs: PRD FR-27:430; docs/judge-layer-ideas.md:98; CONTRACT.md:145-151.
stories.acceptance: The labeled set's minimum contents hold: ≥50 labeled proposals carrying risk + intent-verification labels; every proposal carries a valid risk label (routine|focused|senior-security) and a valid intent-verification label (supports|contradicts|insufficient); ids unique and fixtures present. `bun porting/calibration/validate-labels.mjs` exits 0 printing the proposal count and label distribution; exits non-zero when count < 50 or any row lacks an invalid/missing label.
stories.check_cmd: bun porting/calibration/validate-labels.mjs && jq -ec '((.proposals | length) >= 50) and (([.proposals[] | select((.label.risk == null) or (.label.intent == null))] | length) == 0)' porting/calibration/judge-v1/labels.json
stories.notes: Overlap: `tune-judge-thresholds-on-our-own-labeled-proposals` [pending] names the evaluation but not the corpus; no store row builds a ≥50-proposal labeled set. This is the input artifact the rest of FR-27 consumes.

stories.title: Run the injection-testing spike over the judge-v1 labeled set
stories.scope: porting/calibration/injection-spike.mjs: for every labeled proposal — (a) inject a battery of instruction-like payloads (role prefixes, 'ignore previous instructions', KEY=VALUE secret forms, chat-control tokens, delimiter-escape attempts) into intent and patch text; (b) assert the assembled state strips/scrubs them by importing stripInstructionLike/scrubFreeText/buildJudgeRequest from platform/src/judge.ts and asserting no un-stripped payload bytes and delimited [UNTRUSTED-REPO-DATA] wrapping; (c) call the real pinned model (@cf/cloudflare/clef) with the buildJudgeRequest output — Workers AI REST with the account id + token resolution pattern of porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs:26-37 (never mocks); (d) validate answers with validateJudgeResponse and compare against clean-baseline answers for the same proposal. An escape = payload bytes surviving into the state, a schema-invalid answer, or an unsafe flip vs baseline (risk class drops, or intent flips contradicts→supports) under injection. Writes porting/calibration/judge-v1/injection-spike.json {runAt, model, setId, cases, escapes, pass, details[]}; exit non-zero on any escape. Refs: PRD FR-26:420, FR-27:430; SPINE AD-11; judge.test.mjs (state-assembly suite pattern).
stories.acceptance: The injection-testing spike passes on our labeled set: every labeled proposal × battery case is run live; escapes = 0; every injected case's assembled state contains no un-stripped payload; every live answer validates against the typed schema; the record names the pinned model id and setId v1. `bun porting/calibration/injection-spike.mjs` exits 0 only when escapes = 0 (any escape exits non-zero and lists the case).
stories.check_cmd: bun porting/calibration/injection-spike.mjs && jq -ec '.escapes == 0 and .pass == true and .setId == "v1"' porting/calibration/judge-v1/injection-spike.json
stories.notes: Overlap: `live-only-e2e-verification-gate-before-submission-no-mocks` [pending] (live-only ethos — this spike runs against the real model, no mocks). `auto-land-gate-live` [pending] makes the spike pass a precondition for engagement; this story produces the evidence that row consumes.

stories.title: Build the judge-v1 evaluation harness over the labeled set
stories.scope: porting/calibration/evaluate.mjs: run every labeled proposal through the real judge path — buildJudgeRequest (platform/src/judge.ts) → pinned @cf/cloudflare/clef via Workers AI REST (land-hardening.probe.mjs:26-37 token resolution) → validateJudgeResponse — then score answers against ground-truth labels: per-question precision/recall (risk label; intent verdict), per-class confusion, and the ship-blocking class metrics (class recorded in the output; proposed definition: risk=senior-security ∪ intent=contradicts — the class the gate would refuse). Writes porting/calibration/judge-v1/eval-results.json {runAt, model, setId, proposals:[{id, answer, label, match}], metrics:{perQuestion, shipBlocking:{class, precision, recall, tp, fp, fn}}}. `--check` validates completeness (≥50 evaluated, every answer typed-valid, metrics present) without re-running the model. No mocks. Refs: PRD FR-27:430-431; docs/judge-layer-ideas.md:98,103.
stories.acceptance: The harness evaluates the full labeled set live and emits per-question precision/recall plus ship-blocking-class precision with the class definition recorded. `bun porting/calibration/evaluate.mjs --check` exits 0 only when eval-results.json covers ≥50 proposals, every recorded answer is typed-valid, and both per-question and ship-blocking metrics exist; exits non-zero otherwise.
stories.check_cmd: bun porting/calibration/evaluate.mjs --check && jq -ec '((.proposals | length) >= 50) and (.metrics.perQuestion != null) and ((.metrics.shipBlocking.class | length) > 0)' porting/calibration/judge-v1/eval-results.json
stories.notes: Overlap: `tune-judge-thresholds-on-our-own-labeled-proposals` [pending] ('Run the labeled-set evaluation script; thresholds recorded alongside the set version') — this story is the missing evaluation script; the tuning + record is E5-impl-calibration-record-v1.

stories.title: Tune judge-v1 thresholds and commit the calibration record
stories.scope: Tune the code constants in platform/src/judge.ts (RISK_ROUTINE_MAX, RISK_FOCUSED_MAX, COLLISION_MIN, intent/overclaim cutoffs) against the eval harness until ship-blocking precision ≥0.9, re-running evaluate.mjs after every constant change so the record's metrics reflect the final constants. Commit porting/calibration/judge-v1/calibration-record.json {recordVersion, setId:'v1', model, labeledSet:{path,count≥50}, metrics:{perQuestion, shipBlocking:{class,precision≥0.9,recall}}, thresholds:{...current judge.ts constants...}, injectionSpike:{path,pass:true,escapes:0}, signoff:{name:'John',date}} plus porting/calibration/record-check.mjs: validates every minimum content, imports the live constants + PINNED_MODEL_ID + JUDGE_SET_ID from judge.ts, and fails on drift (record thresholds ≠ code; record model ≠ pinned id; spike not passing). The first version stays advisory-only: the gate remains off until this record exists (FR-26/OQ-5); no wire/contract change. Refs: PRD FR-27:430-432, OQ-5:862; SPINE AD-11; docs/judge-layer-ideas.md:98.
stories.acceptance: The calibration record's minimum contents hold: ≥50 labeled proposals carrying risk + intent-verification labels; precision ≥0.9 on the ship-blocking class; the injection-testing spike passes; sign-off by John. Thresholds/weights/labels are code constants tuned on that labeled set (record.thresholds equals judge.ts) and the record names the pinned model + setId v1. `bun porting/calibration/record-check.mjs` exits 0 only when all minimums hold and thresholds/model/setId match the code; exits non-zero on any drift or missing sign-off.
stories.check_cmd: bun porting/calibration/record-check.mjs && jq -ec '.metrics.shipBlocking.precision >= 0.9 and .injectionSpike.pass == true and ((.signoff.name | length) > 0)' porting/calibration/judge-v1/calibration-record.json
stories.notes: Overlap: `tune-judge-thresholds-on-our-own-labeled-proposals` [pending] (same tuning intent, vague check) and `version-judge-question-sets-in-code-with-the-platform` [pending] (setId echo — already built: JUDGE_SET_ID whitelist; response echoes setId). This story adds the enforced record minimums + drift check. FR-27 consequence 3 (model id logged per response; drift fails closed) is already built (index.ts judge log carries model; judge.ts MODEL_ECHOES/validateJudgeResponse fail closed) and is proven under the E5-verify slice (FR-24) — the record adds calibration provenance only, no rebuild. Sign-off is a human act: the task completes only with John's signoff field; never fabricate it.

stories.title: Enforce the auto-land engagement interlock (off by default, record-gated)
stories.scope: Delta over `auto-land-gate-live` [pending — owns the engaged POST /land gate, the ACT/CONFIRM/ESCALATE mapping, and judge-unavailable fail-closed]. Deliver: platform/src/autoland.ts engagement switch (AUTO_LAND_ENGAGED=false default) + eligibility predicate; /land consults it and makes no judge call while unengaged (observable: zero AI binding use, landing behavior byte-identical to today); when engaged, a favorable judge verdict alone never auto-lands — at least one non-model corroborating signal must be clean: a non-empty diff3 conflict map or unclean fold status blocks auto-land regardless of judge answers (code decides, AD-11). porting/calibration/engagement-check.mjs: fails the repo when AUTO_LAND_ENGAGED is true unless the calibration record passes record-check (exists, spike passes, sign-off present) — engagement cannot ship without the record. Contract suite porting/tests/autoland-gate.test.mjs (worker.fetch, in-memory Artifacts, scripted AI binding — judge.test.mjs pattern): (a) unengaged /land works with AI absent; (b) engaged + judge cannot answer ⇒ 503 judge-unavailable and base ref unchanged (no push, fail closed); (c) engaged + favorable judge + seeded diff3 conflict ⇒ no auto-land; (d) a client-supplied gate flag is rejected/ignored. Refs: PRD FR-26:419-421; SPINE AD-11:123; CONTRACT.md:73-106,143; DESIGN.md:614.
stories.acceptance: Auto-land stays off until an injection-testing spike passes on our labeled set and at least one non-model corroborating signal exists (fold status / conflict map): with AUTO_LAND_ENGAGED=false, POST /land performs no judge call and behaves exactly as today; the engagement guard refuses engagement while the calibration record is absent or failing; when engaged, a non-empty conflict map or unclean fold status blocks auto-land even on favorable judge answers, and a judge that cannot answer fails /land closed (no push). `bun porting/tests/autoland-gate.test.mjs && bun porting/calibration/engagement-check.mjs` exits 0 with the four scenarios green.
stories.notes: Overlap: `auto-land-gate-live` [pending] IS the engaged gate + fail-closed core — this story authors only the interlock delta: default-off provability, the record-gated engagement guard, and the non-model corroboration requirement. FR-26 is unsequenced by design (non-goal for M1: no demo or first-version path auto-lands; PRD:416).

stories.title: Render auto-land verdicts behind the Land button (render, never decide)
stories.scope: platform/ui: add the pure view mapping platform/ui/land-verdict.js (ESM module imported by app.js — app.js already loads as a module, index.html:132) turning the server gate verdict on /land responses into card presentation only — ACT: normal land flow; CONFIRM: reuse the existing amber inline confirming state ('confirm land?' anatomy, app.js:581-585); ESCALATE: red advisory badge next to Land, the button never auto-fires; judge-unavailable/fail-closed: honest blocked banner carrying the server reason, no bypass action. Wire it into handleLandProposal/renderProposals; zero client-side thresholds/weights — the verdict is read from the response, never recomputed ('the judge advises; code decides; humans still own irreversible acts'). CONFIRM/ESCALATE vocabulary comes from the `auto-land-gate-live` CONTRACT bump (AD-11). Per DESIGN.md:606-614 the chips keep the existing badge language; red only for the ESCALATE advisory display — never dressing a soft collision. Test porting/tests/autoland-ui.test.mjs exercises the pure mapping (verdict→presentation, no-auto-fire, fail-closed display) from server-shaped inputs only. Refs: PRD FR-26:421; UX EXPERIENCE.md:273; DESIGN.md:606-614; CONTRACT.md:143.
stories.acceptance: Clients render verdicts; they never decide them: from server responses alone, the card maps ACT/CONFIRM/ESCALATE per DESIGN.md:614 (CONFIRM reuses the amber confirming state; ESCALATE surfaces as a red badge next to Land and the button never auto-fires); a fail-closed /land response (503 judge-unavailable) renders a blocked state with the server's reason and no bypass; no client-side threshold/weight/decision logic exists on the path. `node --check platform/ui/land-verdict.js && node --check platform/ui/app.js && bun porting/tests/autoland-ui.test.mjs` exits 0.
stories.check_cmd: node --check platform/ui/land-verdict.js && node --check platform/ui/app.js && bun porting/tests/autoland-ui.test.mjs
stories.notes: Overlap: `auto-land-gate-live` [pending] (server side of the gate); `complete-unified-proposal-card-intent-diff-risk-provenance` and `proposal-card-signal-set-risk-provenance-fields-on-every-car` [pending] cover card signal fields, not the gate verdict. UX-DR-2 build gap (EXPERIENCE.md:273): the judge-chip half is already built (judgeChipsHtml, app.js:460-500) and its proof lives in the E5-verify slice (FR-25); this story is the missing gate-behind-the-Land-button half.
